title: Salesforce Platform Developer II
goal: Pass the Salesforce Platform Developer II certification exam

exam.name: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
exam.verify_note: Section weights 15/27/20/20/18, 60 questions, 120 minutes and a 70% pass mark are from the Winter '24-era exam guide as best known; third-party sources disagree on the weights. Confirm against the official exam guide on Trailhead, then edit and re-import.

concepts.title: Apex classes, interfaces and access modifiers
concepts.objective: Write classes and interfaces; use static vs instance members, constructors, inheritance and access modifiers.

concepts.title: Abstract and virtual classes, and polymorphism
concepts.objective: Use abstract and virtual classes, overrides and interfaces to vary behaviour without branching.

concepts.title: Apex design patterns: service, selector, domain, factory, singleton
concepts.objective: Recognise and apply common Apex patterns (service, selector, domain, unit of work, factory, singleton) and say when each helps.

concepts.title: Dynamic Apex: Schema describe, dynamic SOQL and generic sObjects
concepts.objective: Use Schema describe calls, Database.query with bind variables and generic sObject access, including their limits and security risks.

concepts.title: Custom metadata types and custom settings
concepts.objective: Store configuration in custom metadata or custom settings instead of hard-coding, and know which deploys with metadata.

concepts.title: Custom labels, translation and multi-currency in code
concepts.objective: Write code and UI that respect custom labels, translations, user locale and multi-currency fields.

concepts.title: with sharing, without sharing, inherited sharing
concepts.objective: Pick the sharing keyword for a class and predict which records a query returns.

concepts.title: Apex managed sharing and share objects
concepts.objective: Grant and revoke record access in code with share objects and Apex sharing reasons, and know when declarative sharing is better.

concepts.title: Future methods
concepts.objective: Use @future (including callout=true) and know its parameter and chaining restrictions.

concepts.title: Queueable Apex
concepts.objective: Use Queueable for non-primitive state and chaining, and monitor jobs with AsyncApexJob.

concepts.title: Batch Apex
concepts.objective: Implement start/execute/finish, choose a scope size, and use Database.Stateful when state must carry over.

concepts.title: Choosing and chaining asynchronous Apex
concepts.objective: Choose between future, Queueable, Batch, Schedulable and platform events for a requirement, and chain or monitor jobs within limits, including Queueable finalizers.

concepts.title: Bulkified triggers and the handler pattern
concepts.objective: Write triggers that handle 200 records per batch, one trigger per object with logic in a handler class.

concepts.title: Trigger frameworks: handlers, bypass switches and recursion control
concepts.objective: Design a trigger framework with one trigger per object, handler classes, configurable bypass and recursion control.

concepts.title: Transactions, savepoints and recursion control
concepts.objective: Reason about transaction boundaries, use Savepoint and rollback, and prevent trigger recursion with static state.

concepts.title: Record locking and concurrency
concepts.objective: Use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, avoid lock contention and handle UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW errors.

concepts.title: Platform events
concepts.objective: Publish and subscribe to platform events from Apex, triggers and Flow, and know publish-immediately vs after-commit.

concepts.title: Change Data Capture
concepts.objective: Subscribe to Change Data Capture events in Apex triggers and external clients, and choose it over custom platform events when it fits.

concepts.title: HTTP callouts with Named and External Credentials
concepts.objective: Make REST and SOAP callouts from Apex using Named and External Credentials, within callout limits and transaction rules.

concepts.title: Exposing Apex as REST and SOAP web services
concepts.objective: Build @RestResource and webservice methods, handle requests and responses, and secure them.

concepts.title: Calling Apex from Flow with invocable methods
concepts.objective: Expose bulk-safe @InvocableMethod and @InvocableVariable to Flow.

concepts.title: Lightning Web Component structure and decorators
concepts.objective: Build a component's HTML, JS and meta files, use @api, @track and @wire, and the lifecycle hooks.

concepts.title: Getting data into LWC: LDS, wire adapters, Apex
concepts.objective: Choose Lightning Data Service, wire adapters or imperative Apex (@AuraEnabled cacheable) and handle errors.

concepts.title: Keeping LWC data fresh: refreshApex, record notifications and caching
concepts.objective: Refresh wired data with refreshApex, notify Lightning Data Service of record changes, and reason about the client cache.

concepts.title: Component communication and Lightning Message Service
concepts.objective: Pass data down with public properties, up with custom events, and across the page with Lightning Message Service.

concepts.title: Navigation, toasts and quick actions in LWC
concepts.objective: Use NavigationMixin, show toast events, and build screen and headless quick actions with LWC.

concepts.title: Lightning Web Components in Flow
concepts.objective: Build LWCs for Flow screens (inputs, outputs, validation, navigation events) and launch flows from LWC.

concepts.title: Visualforce pages and controllers
concepts.objective: Use standard controllers, extensions and custom controllers, and know when Visualforce is the right tool.

concepts.title: Advanced Visualforce: view state, pagination and JavaScript remoting
concepts.objective: Manage view state with transient variables, paginate with StandardSetController, and use JavaScript remoting.

concepts.title: Preventing XSS and injection in UI code
concepts.objective: Escape output in Visualforce, rely on Lightning Web Security and Locker, and avoid SOQL injection from UI input.

concepts.title: Apex test classes, assertions and coverage
concepts.objective: Write @isTest classes with meaningful assertions, know the 75% coverage rule and test data isolation (SeeAllData).

concepts.title: Test data factories and @testSetup
concepts.objective: Create data with factory classes, @testSetup and Test.loadData.

concepts.title: Test.startTest/stopTest and testing async code
concepts.objective: Use startTest/stopTest to reset limits and force async work to complete before assertions.

concepts.title: System.runAs and callout mocks
concepts.objective: Test sharing and permissions with runAs, and callouts with HttpCalloutMock and Test.setMock.

concepts.title: Stub API, mocks and dependency injection
concepts.objective: Isolate the unit under test with the Stub API (System.StubProvider), interfaces and dependency injection.

concepts.title: Testing callouts, platform events and async chains
concepts.objective: Test callouts with mocks, deliver platform events in tests, and test chained asynchronous work.

concepts.title: Testing Lightning Web Components with Jest
concepts.objective: Know what Jest tests cover for LWC and how wire adapters and Apex are mocked.

concepts.title: Debug logs, Developer Console and the Replay Debugger
concepts.objective: Set trace flags and log levels, read a debug log, and use checkpoints and the Apex Replay Debugger.

concepts.title: Deploying: change sets, Salesforce CLI and packages
concepts.objective: Deploy with change sets, the Salesforce CLI and Metadata API, or unlocked packages, and know the test requirements for production.

concepts.title: Unlocked packages, scratch orgs and CI pipelines
concepts.objective: Structure work as unlocked or second-generation packages, use scratch orgs, and run tests in a CI pipeline.

concepts.title: Writing code within governor limits
concepts.objective: Avoid SOQL and DML inside loops, read the Limits class, and know the key per-transaction limits.

concepts.title: Selective queries, indexes and the Query Plan tool
concepts.objective: Write selective SOQL that uses indexes, read the Query Plan tool, and know when custom indexes or skinny tables help.

concepts.title: Large data volumes, data skew and bulk processing
concepts.objective: Process large data volumes with Batch Apex and the Bulk API, and avoid ownership and lookup skew.

concepts.title: Apex CPU time, heap size and efficient code
concepts.objective: Diagnose and reduce CPU time and heap use (collections, loops, string building, queries) with the Limits class and debug logs.

concepts.title: Platform Cache
concepts.objective: Use org and session cache partitions to cut repeated queries and callouts, handling cache misses safely.

concepts.title: LWC performance: lazy loading, caching and rendering
concepts.objective: Speed up components with cacheable Apex, lazy loading, pagination and fewer re-renders.
